description: The project's saved tests (Test Lab's library), newest change first: each test's id, name, mode (regular, red_team, bias), its category, whether it is new, the suites it is in, the start of its instructions, and how its last run went. Filter by suite, mode, category or name, or to new tests only. Use the ids with run_tests, get_test and update_test.

category.description: A regular test category (id or name, as list_test_categories shows it). Red team and bias tests are grouped by their attack and bias types instead.
category.title: Category

new_only.description: Only tests a generation wrote that nobody has opened yet.
new_only.title: New Only

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

search.description: Only tests whose name contains this.
search.title: Search

sort.description: updated: latest change first; name: A to Z; last_run: latest run first; runs: most runs first.
sort.title: Sort

suite.description: Only the tests of this suite (id or name).
suite.title: Suite

name: list_tests
